gloss: to appear on the market, to circulate

definitions.gloss: to appear on the market, to be widely available, to circulate
definitions.explanation: For goods, products, or information to become widely available or to spread through circulation.

examples.japanese: {新米|しんまい}が{出回|でまわ}る{季節|きせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's the season when new rice appears on the market.

examples.japanese: {偽物|にせもの}が{市場|しじょう}に{出回|でまわ}っている。
examples.english: Counterfeit goods are circulating in the market.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{新鮮|しんせん}な{山菜|さんさい}が{店頭|てんとう}に{出回|でまわ}り{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: When spring comes, fresh mountain vegetables start appearing in stores.

notes:
Compound verb from {出|で}る (to come out) + {回|まわ}る (to go around). Describes goods, products, or information becoming widely available.

TRANSITIVITY:
・Type: intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
・No transitive pair

ASPECT (ている):
・{出回|でまわ}っている = is circulating, is widely available (ongoing state)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{市場|しじょう}に{出回|でまわ}る (to appear on the market)
・{店頭|てんとう}に{出回|でまわ}る (to appear in stores)
・{偽物|にせもの}が{出回|でまわ}る (counterfeits circulate)
・{情報|じょうほう}が{出回|でまわ}る (information circulates)
・〜が{出回|でまわ}る{時期|じき} (the time when ~ becomes available)

USAGE NOTES:
Often used for seasonal produce ({旬|しゅん}の{食材|しょくざい}) appearing in stores, or negatively for counterfeit goods, rumors, or leaked information spreading.
